objective: WP06: evaluate source fidelity and usable combat choreography after the library retrieval changes.

planned_execution.setting: Fresh isolated agents, fork_turns none, inherited host model and reasoning, no override. Exact serving model identifier unavailable.
planned_execution.permitted_inputs: Corresponding frozen skill package, case request and own working directory.
planned_execution.prohibited_side_effects: No source edits, media generation, external platform calls, networking or further agents.
planned_execution.logging: Direct input reads and hashes, actual commands and saved outputs. Self-reported, not OS-level access tracing.
planned_execution.protocol_note: Five candidate runs existed before this resumed turn. Remaining dispatches clarify administrative log handling only; user requests and task resources are unchanged.

review_design.method: Anonymous per-case A/B presentation with deterministic random ordering; original outputs retained.
review_design.inputs: Original requests, paired anonymous answers and the pinned upstream source as reference data. No condition mapping, implementation findings or expected answers.
review_design.criteria: User constraints, action/response/recovery continuity, source attribution and disclosed additions. Judge semantic behavior, not keywords.
review_design.limitations: Single draws and model-based semantic review cannot establish population success rates or video quality.

completion_policy: Report every run and failure. Preserve original evidence. If behavior requires code changes, freeze and label the revised candidate separately and test affected cases; do not rewrite initial outputs.
evidence_limits: No video, engine or account behavior evaluated.
Retrieval character measurements use the separate 0.8.3 baseline and are not WP06 results.
Current repository may contain unrelated ongoing research changes; frozen runtime snapshots remain the task authority.

actual_execution.confirmed_completion: Fresh agent terminal results; each run archived only after completion.
actual_execution.serving_model: unknown; inherited host settings; no override
